pack: B3 airlift and gunship aircraft, support-power icons
regenerate: SA_ASSET_HOME=/home/claude python3 -I tools/art/air_c5_3d.py ; python3 -I tools/art/render_power_icons.py ; godot --headless --path godot --import

aircraft_models.representation: 3D model (glTF binary, embedded 2048 px albedo atlas)
aircraft_models.method: Original geometry lofted from pixel measurements on the client's concept turnaround (side + top views); albedo by depth-tested projection of those views plus baked AO (see docs/M3_AIRCRAFT.md method).

reference.provenance: client-supplied generated 2D turnaround sheet (U.S. Airlift Aircraft Image Pack, Oct 2026)

nodes: NoseDoor (visor, pivot on its hinge; rotate +X to lift)
aircraft_models.notes: New in B3. Drawn at 0.45 scale in game (Battle.C5_SCALE). Preview sheet docs/screens/b3_c5_sheet.png.
aircraft_models.license_status: geometry project-owned; texture derived from client-supplied generated concept art - confirm generator terms before release
aircraft_models.shipping_status: DEV ONLY - release review required: depicts a real aircraft design and uses its real designation (trademark review); no national insignia on the model (team-colour panels only)
